mapper.select:
select em.evaluation_material_id as "evaluationMaterialId", em.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", em.area_code as "areaCode", em.organization_code as "organizationCode", em.target_user_id as "targetUserId", em.source_achievement_id as "sourceAchievementId", em.material_status as "materialStatus", coalesce(latest.previous_score, em.calculated_score) as "previousScore", coalesce(latest.recalculated_score, em.calculated_score) as "recalculatedScore", latest.formula_version_id as "formulaVersionId", latest.generation_no as "generationNo", latest.recalculation_batch_id as "recalculationBatchId", latest.selection_reason as "selectionReason", case when em.deleted_yn = 'Y' then '삭제 표시 평가자료는 재계산 대상에서 제외됩니다.' when em.material_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' then '평가확정 자료는 확정취소 후 재계산할 수 있습니다.' else null end as "excludedReason", latest.created_at as "calculatedAt" from evaluation_materials em left join lateral ( select scg.previous_score, scg.recalculated_score, scg.formula_version_id, scg.generation_no, scg.recalculation_batch_id, scg.selection_reason, scg.created_at from score_calculation_generations scg where scg.evaluation_material_id = em.evaluation_material_id order by scg.generation_no desc limit 1 ) latest on true
order by coalesce(latest.created_at, em.updated_at, em.created_at) desc, em.evaluation_material_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select formula_version_id as "formulaVersionId", calculation_type as "calculationType", lower_bound_score as "lowerBoundScore", upper_bound_score as "upperBoundScore" from calculation_formula_versions where formula_version_id = #{formulaVersionId} and evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and active_yn = 'Y' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_jobs (batch_job_id, batch_type, evaluation_year, area_code, organization_code, target_user_id, target_condition_json, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, job_status, requested_by, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, 'SCORE_RECALCULATION', #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.areaCode}, null, #{request.targetUserId}, jsonb_build_object('evaluationYear', #{request.evaluationYear}, 'areaCode', #{request.areaCode}, 'targetUserId', #{request.targetUserId}, 'formulaVersionId', #{parsedFormulaVersionId}, 'selectionReason', #{request.selectionReason}), #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestedBy}, #{requestId}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedBy})

insert into evaluation_batch_job_items (batch_job_id, target_ref, result_status, error_code, error_message, excluded_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, #{targetRef}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{excludedReason}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update evaluation_batch_jobs set success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, excluded_count = #{excludedCount}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where batch_job_id = #{batchJobId}
mapper.insert: insert into score_calculation_generations (evaluation_material_id, formula_version_id, previous_score, recalculated_score, base_score, participation_type, distribution_rate, cap_applied_yn, selection_reason, generation_no, recalculation_batch_id, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{candidate.evaluationMaterialId}, #{formulaVersionId}, #{previousScore}, #{recalculatedScore}, #{candidate.baseScore}, #{candidate.participationType}, #{candidate.distributionRate}, #{candidate.capAppliedYn}, #{selectionReason}, #{candidate.nextGenerationNo}, #{batchJobId}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy}) on conflict (evaluation_material_id, generation_no) do nothing
mapper.update: update evaluation_materials set calculated_score = #{recalculatedScore}, score_basis_ref = concat('B46-SCORE:', #{batchJobId}, ':', #{evaluationMaterialId}, ':G', #{generationNo}), request_id = #{requestId}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where evaluation_material_id = #{evaluationMaterialId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and material_status != 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
